extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Edinburgh Sheriff Court asks whether funding of £20,000 is available, with matrimonial property of around £200,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the detail provided. So that we can review it properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the court and jurisdiction in which the action is raised, the date of any forthcoming hearing or proof, and a breakdown of the matrimonial property and how it is held. It would also help to have an estimate of costs to proof and details of any other funding in place. We will come back to you once the matter has been reviewed.
